cues.en: Step five Modelling.
cues.zh: 第五步，建模。

cues.en: Part two Choosing.
cues.zh: 第二部分，選擇模型。

cues.en: We mentioned in the last lesson, there were three parts to modeling choosing a model, tuning a model and comparing models.
cues.zh: 上一堂提過，建模有三部分：選模型、調模型，以及比較模型。

cues.en: Once you've got your data split into training, validation and test sets, you can start to go through each of these steps.
cues.zh: 資料分成訓練、驗證與測試集後，就能逐步進行。

cues.en: In this lesson, we're going to cover some points on choosing a model, which is you choose a model and train it on your training data.
cues.zh: 這堂介紹選模型，也就是挑選模型，再用訓練資料訓練。

cues.en: Unlike creating your own algorithms from scratch, there are many prebuilt machine learning models which you can take advantage of when you first begin.
cues.zh: 不用從零寫演算法，剛開始就能利用許多現成模型。

cues.en: Your main goal will be knowing what kind of machine learning algorithm to use with what kind of problem this is because some algorithms work better than others on different types of data.
cues.zh: 主要目標是知道哪種問題該用哪種演算法，因為不同演算法適合不同資料。

cues.en: We'll have a look at this specifically when we get hands on with our projects.
cues.zh: 實作專案時會具體介紹。

cues.en: But for now, a tidbit to remember is if you're working with structured data, decision trees such as
cues.zh: 目前先記住，結構化資料通常適合決策樹，像，

cues.en: random forests and gradient boosting algorithms like Cat Boost and XG Boost tend to work best.
cues.zh: 隨機森林，以及 CatBoost、XGBoost 等梯度提升演算法。

cues.en: And if you're working with unstructured data, deep learning neural networks and transfer learning tend to work best.
cues.zh: 非結構化資料則通常適合深度學習神經網路與遷移學習。

cues.en: Once you've chosen a model, your next step is to train them.
cues.zh: 選好模型後，下一步就是訓練。

cues.en: The main goal here will be to line up the inputs and outputs.
cues.zh: 主要目標是把輸入和輸出對應起來。

cues.en: For example, in our heart disease problem, we want our model to look at the feature variables, the
cues.zh: 例如心臟病問題，希望模型查看特徵變數，

cues.en: inputs, and then find the patterns and use them to predict the target variable.
cues.zh: 也就是輸入，找到模式，再用來預測目標變數。

cues.en: So remember from a previous lesson these variables here are the feature variables.
cues.zh: 還記得前一堂，這些就是特徵變數。

cues.en: We want to use these to predict the target variables.
cues.zh: 希望用它們預測目標變數。

cues.en: Another common naming setting is to use X, which is the data to predict Y, which is the labels.
cues.zh: 另一種常見命名方式是用 X，也就是資料，預測 y，也就是標籤。

cues.en: Different machine learning algorithms have different ways of doing this.
cues.zh: 不同演算法有不同做法。

cues.en: We'll see how to do it for a handful of useful ones in future projects.
cues.zh: 之後專案會看到幾種實用演算法如何完成。

cues.en: And remember, training a model takes place on the training data split.
cues.zh: 記住，模型是在訓練集上訓練。

cues.en: This is where your model learns the course material.
cues.zh: 這是模型學習教材的地方。

cues.en: We don't want to let our models cheat and see the final exam before they do their study.
cues.zh: 不希望模型作弊，還沒讀書就先看期末考。

cues.en: Depending on how much data you have and how complex your model is, training may take a while.
cues.zh: 依資料量與模型複雜度，訓練可能花一些時間。

cues.en: One of your biggest goals when training a model is to minimize the times between experiments.
cues.zh: 訓練的一大目標，是縮短實驗之間的時間。

cues.en: So sometimes this will mean to use a small portion of your data first.
cues.zh: 有時代表先用一小部分資料。

cues.en: For example, if your training dataset had 100,000 examples, you might start training a model with only the first 10,000 and see how it goes.
cues.zh: 例如訓練集有 100,000 個範例，先用前 10,000 個訓練，看看效果。

cues.en: You might also decide to use a less complicated model to begin with.
cues.zh: 也可以先選比較簡單的模型。

cues.en: Deep models such as neural networks generally take longer to train than other kinds of models.
cues.zh: 神經網路等深度模型，通常比其他模型訓練更久。

cues.en: Now, this is something worth considering when it comes to training your own models.
cues.zh: 自行訓練時，這點值得考量。

cues.en: For example, if an experiment takes you 3 hours or even up to a couple of days for a small percentage
cues.zh: 如果實驗花 3 小時，甚至幾天，卻只換來，

cues.en: boost in performance of your model you might consider, is this experiment actually worth it?
cues.zh: 模型效能小幅提升，就要想，這次實驗值得嗎？

cues.en: Because machine learning is highly iterative, we want to minimize this experimentation time that we can go from step one to step two to step three.
cues.zh: 機器學習需要不斷迭代，所以希望縮短實驗時間，才能快速走過第一、二、三步。

cues.en: But again, if this looks confusing, we'll see it in practice in the hands on projects.
cues.zh: 看不懂也別擔心，實作專案會看到。

cues.en: The things to remember.
cues.zh: 要記住幾點。

cues.en: Some models work better than others in different problems.
cues.zh: 不同問題，適合的模型不同。

cues.en: Don't be afraid to try things.
cues.zh: 別怕嘗試。

cues.en: And this is really important.
cues.zh: 這非常重要。

cues.en: Machine learning is, as we said before, a highly iterative process.
cues.zh: 機器學習是高度迭代的過程。

cues.en: So some things that you try out may not work the first time, and that means you just neglect that thing going forward and try something else.
cues.zh: 有些方法第一次沒有效果，就先放下，換個方法試試。

cues.en: Start small and build up.
cues.zh: 從小開始，逐步擴充。

cues.en: Add complexity as you need.
cues.zh: 需要時再增加複雜度。

cues.en: What this means is, for example, if you had 100,000 examples, we're going to start on 10,000.
cues.zh: 例如有 100,000 個範例，就先用 10,000 個。

cues.en: We're going to use a simple model first to begin with, rather than going to the the biggest and latest and greatest model.
cues.zh: 先使用簡單模型，不要一開始就選最大、最新、最厲害的模型。

cues.en: Because what we're after is practical results, not something that's that's the the best on paper.
cues.zh: 追求的是實際結果，不只是紙上最好看的。

cues.en: We want to see something that can actually be used in the real world.
cues.zh: 希望真的能在現實世界使用。

cues.en: And part of your experiments will involve tuning a model which shows good initial results to get better results, like tuning a car.
cues.zh: 實驗的一部分，是調整初步結果不錯的模型，讓它更好，就像調校汽車。

cues.en: If your car does well on on one track, it might not do well on another track.
cues.zh: 車在某個賽道表現好，不一定適合另一個。

cues.en: So you tune it up.
cues.zh: 所以需要調校。

cues.en: Let's have a look at how to do that.
cues.zh: 來看看怎麼做。

cues.en: But instead of for cars, we'll do it for machine learning models.
cues.zh: 但我們調的不是汽車，是機器學習模型。
